remarks: Prepare to be wowed by this 7-bedroom, 8/2-bath estate nestled on nearly 3 stunning acres with a pool and tennis court in the Old Hill neighborhood of Westport. This remarkable 9,500 +/- sq ft home finished on three floors effortlessly blends serenity with modern luxury providing exceptionally designed spaces inside and out for entertaining and relaxation. Enter through stone pillars to a serene retreat featuring a grand 2-story foyer, a state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen, and a spacious great room with a stunning fieldstone fireplace. Graciously sized rooms with an open floor plan make this home ideal for today's lifestyle. Providing ample room to work, play, entertain and recharge this home includes a partially finished walk-out lower level with a bedroom, full bath, and gym. The outdoor space is a private sanctuary, bordered by a 62-acre wildlife reserve providing privacy despite being minutes from commuting, shopping, and schools. Enjoy enchanting gardens, a heated gunite pool with an outdoor kitchen, a tennis court, and ample flat lawns. This home provides an unparalleled lifestyle with its blend of elegance, comfort, and breathtaking natural beauty. Experience the best in this extraordinary property, where every detail is designed for luxurious living while being centrally located in the heart of all that Westport has to offer.
